description: arXiv:2610.21281v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Root-cause analysis (RCA) in large-scale distributed systems is challenging because a single symptom can cross service, data, configuration, compute, and organizational boundaries. Responders must assemble incomplete evidence and coordinate experts who hold different parts of the causal path. Generic language-model agents do not solve this problem...
author: Pradipta Ghosh, Gaurav Mitra, Shripad Nadgowda, Akshil Shah, Junyu Liu, Canturk Isci, Syamla Bandla, Xinyao Hu, Onkar Deshpande, Anik Dasgupta
